verdict.rationale: Brevo documents managing campaigns from AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude through its MCP integration. It also documents segments and scheduled sends, so an agent can plausibly build a campaign against a segment and set a future send time rather than sending immediately. However, no evidence describes a draft state, an approval queue, or a human sign-off gate before send, and the scheduling citation appears tied to transactional email. missing for 10: documented campaign draft/approval workflow, explicit scheduling of marketing campaigns via API/MCP, segment targeting of campaigns via the agent interface, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Create as many segments as you need.
Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future.
